answer: At the end of the dock, feet hanging over the water.
The rope tied to the post.
She didn't move; she stayed sitting still.
Very faint ripple rings near the surface by the dock, barely visible; the view also seemed to push in slightly. Nothing clearly spread across the water.
It stayed tight and still, a straight line angled down into the water, with no visible tugging.
Down into the water, at a slant, from the post down and away under the dock.
